rows.en:
So he snuck into the Academy on his own again,
did he...
Oh, Hilda-sensei.

Calling him "that guy"...
Hilda-sensei, do you know Luis-san?
Actually, are you two close, maybe?
Close?

Ha ha, give me a break.
There's no way that's true...

That's quite the funny joke you've got there,
\p...!!

Eek!!
I'm sorry for saying you were close!
Hilda-sensei!!
(D-does she really hate Luis-san that much...?)

Well, I'll tell you this much:
you'd do better not to get too involved
with that guy.
He's a troublemaker, that one...
A troublemaker...?

I can't count how many times he's landed us
in danger on the battlefield...
Even that time...!
...The battlefield?
...It's nothing. Forget it.

Anyway, while you're at it, forget about him too
and enjoy Sports Day.

Got it? You're forgetting about him!
Forget him right now! Wipe him from your
memory immediately!!
Y-yes, ma'am! Hilda-sensei!!
Heh, as long as you understand.

(In the end, I still have no idea
what kind of person Luis-san is.)

(Well, whatever.
I probably won't ever run into Luis-san again
anyway...)

(All right! Just like Hilda-sensei said,
I'm gonna enjoy Sports Day!)
NUMBER OOOOOOOOONE!!!

(Who'd have thought Luis-san would crash
the relay and turn Sports Day
into total chaos...)
(Luis-san really is a troublemaker...)

(I just have a feeling I'll keep running into
Luis-san from now on...
Maybe I should try to get along with him?)

(He doesn't seem like a bad person...
I-it'll be fine, right?)

(All right, today's Sports Day!
I'm gonna do my best to shine too!)

Kagura-kun, Saotome-kun,
both of you calm down...

(This team sure is a mess...
Are we really going to be okay?)

(Well, whatever happens, happens...
Now, time to start my warm-up stret...)
rows.notes: Interrupted mid-word, as the Japanese trails off.

rows.en: Hey, girl, what's your name?
M-my name's \p.

Heh, see you around,
Fresh Girl!
Huh? Fresh Girl...?
(Oh, he's gone...)

(Who on earth is this Luis-san?
He might even be someone dangerous...)

(In the end, I still have no idea
what kind of person Luis-san is.)
(Luis-san really is a troublemaker...)

(I just have a feeling I'll keep running into
Luis-san from now on...
Maybe I should try to get along with him?)

(He doesn't seem like a bad person...
I-it'll be fine, right?)

(Next class is Gary-sensei's Practical Training.
I bet it's gonna be another tough one today...)
rows.notes: jitsugi kunren rendered with the glossary class name Practical Training.

rows.en:
All right, you lot! Class is starting!
Keep your guard up!

...Oh, before that, there's something
I oughta tell you.

Today we've got a guest here to observe
classes at Mihoshi Academy.

I am Lieutenant Catherine Glass,
of the New U.N. Forces General Staff.

Today I have come to observe classes at Mihoshi
Academy, the fleet's finest school for
training specialists.

Don't you lot go getting nervous just because
a beauty like this is watching.

Oh my, a beauty? Even if it's just flattery,
I'm delighted.

Flattery? Not at all.
I'm only stating the facts...

Gary... What do you think you're doing
in the middle of class?

Right, introductions are done, so let's start!
Don't you dare slack off, you lot!
Geez, that Gary...

(An officer from the New U.N. Forces coming
to observe us... Mihoshi really is something.
Oops, I need to focus on class right now...)

All right! That's it for today's class!
Next class I'm gonna be even tougher,
so brace yourselves!

(Phew, I'm beat again today...
Okay, back to the classroom...)
Do you have a moment?

Yes?
Umm... Catherine-san?

Just Cathy is fine,
\p-kun.
Huh?! How do you know my name?
I asked Gary-sensei your name a little earlier.
Umm... What exactly can I do for you?

I'll get straight to the point...
Would you be interested in joining
the New U.N. Forces?

Watching today's class, I saw something
in you that shows real talent.

The New U.N. Forces are seriously short
of people right now. Finding kids who seem
talented is the purpose of today's visit.
Otherwise, the "other guys" will snap them up...
rows.notes: Japanese 'atchi' (that side), unexplained here; likely S.M.S. Kept vague.

rows.en: (The "other guys"?)

I know you can't give me an answer just like that.
Take your time and think it over.
Well then, I'll take my leave for today.

(Whew, that surprised me...
Who'd have thought the New U.N. Forces
would try to scout me...)

(It's not something I can decide that easily.
I'd better think it over carefully...)

(Next class is Gary-sensei's Practical Training.
I bet it's gonna be another tough one today...)

(An officer from the New U.N. Forces coming
to observe us... Mihoshi really is something.
Oops, I need to focus on class right now...)

Just Cathy is fine,
\p-san.
Huh?! How do you know my name?

(It's not something I can decide that easily.
I'd better think it over carefully...)

uncertain: c21552/c21553: Cathy's 'atchi' (that side) left vague as 'the "other guys"'; context suggests S.M.S. but the scene never says so.
c21532: chuui rendered in full as 'Lieutenant' in spoken self-introduction (glossary rank list abbreviates to Lt.).
c21508/c21509: Luis's 'ore ga...' / 'ichiban daaaa' split across two rows as "I'm......." / "NUMBER OOOOONE!!!".
